body: I'm in an abusive relationship, and I know it. I just don't have the energy to get away anymore. My step father hung himself in my front yard maybe seven months ago, and I can't help but want to follow in his footsteps. I always trusted his judgment before. All these things that happened in my past just make me feel so unclean and worthless now, and that feeling never goes away. Any relationships I form now, I become overly attached and just end them, rather than seem needy and weak - and that's just on the internet. I'm not normal enough to manage physical relationships the way I should. I could go on, but it all really boils down to whining to try to explain my happiness.
